current_evidence: The council's 'What you need to get planning permission' page links this PDF as 'Validation guidance and local information requirements for planning applications' ('the local list of validation requirements'), first published 29/04/2024 and last updated 24/10/2025.

issues.detail: The list date comes from PDF metadata (CreationDate), giving 2025-10-01. The council page gives the real date: last updated 24 October 2025, first published 29 April 2024. The date should be 2025-10-24, and the date basis should be the page text.
issues.evidence: Council page: 'Validation guidance and local information requirements for planning applications ... First published 29/04/2024; last updated 24/10/2025'

issues.detail: The Householder, Outline, Reserved matters, Listed building, Advertisement, LDC and Works to trees rows come mostly from old per-application-type form checklists dated July/December 2013, not from the current Oct 2025 local list. Their triggers are out of date and clash with the current list. Examples: Retail Impact Assessment over 2,500 sq.m (old outline checklist) vs 350 sq.m in the current list (item 55); DAS cites the 'Order 2010/2012'; Heritage Statement cites 'NPPF Para 128' (2012 NPPF); Transport Assessment cites the 'Ensuring a Choice of Travel SPD'; plans requested 'on a CD as well as the paper copies'. The same requirement can therefore appear with two contradictory triggers (Full planning vs Outline).
issues.evidence: Excerpts: 'Site plan to mark width and location of new or widened access in July 2013'; 'Retail Impact Assessment for out-of-town centre retail/town centre uses exceeding 2,500 square metres' vs '55 Retail Impact Assessment ... main town centre uses of 350sqm or more'

issues.detail: In rows taken from the Oct 2025 list, text from neighbouring items in the PDF table has been mixed in, so many requirements carry another item's trigger. Heritage Statement (35) shows '1000sq.m ... 10 or more new dwellings' instead of a heritage-asset trigger. Tree Survey (17) shows the IAQM/EPUK air-quality criteria. Sustainability Statement (60) shows 'substantial demolition of a non-designated heritage asset' (the Structural Report trigger). Structural Report (59) is just 'units (outline and full)'. EIA shows daylight/sunlight wording ('adjoining properties ... vicinity of a river or open space'). Daylight/Sunlight shows Highways pre-app help text. Employment row merges '29 Employment and Skills Statement 30 External Wall Construction Report'. Other triggers are bare fragments: Air Quality ('and an Air Quality Impact Assessment is required'), Transport ('see also Transport Assessment;'), S106 ('policy compliant planning obligations.'), Tall buildings ('that involves a tall building.').
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpts quoted from validation-checklist-oct-25.pdf, e.g. 'requirement 17 (Arboricultur al) Tree Survey ... Please see IAQM/EPUK Land-Use Planning & Development Control for criteria'

issues.detail: Some requirement names do not match their source text. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' under Full planning is actually item 19 Arboricultural Method Statement (trees within 15x stem diameter of the working area). 'Parking provision' quotes advertisement mounting details. 'Advertisement drawings / illumination' under Full planning is just 'intensity of illumination...'. 'Photographs / Photomontages' and 'Design and Access Statement' both carry the BNG item 8 text.
issues.evidence: '19 Arboricultural Method Statement Any application where there are trees within proximity of the working area of the site...'

issues.detail: Around 40 rows are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', but the current list gives triggers by development type, and several items say 'All applications'. For example, 21 Biodiversity Checklist and 8 BNG statement ('All applications') appear only under Full planning, not Householder, Outline or LBC. 13 Accessibility Statement ('new residential accommodation, including new build, change of use and conversions') is put under 'Change of use - prior approval', which is a planning-application trigger, not prior approval. 'Waste / Refuse' is put under 'Minerals & waste (county)' from a fragment ('the landfill / waste management operation.') although Liverpool is a unitary authority, so no county tier applies. Telecoms supplementary info is under Full planning.
issues.evidence: '21 Biodiversity Checklist All applications.'; '13 Accessibility Statement ... All applications that involve the creation of any new residential accommodation, including new build, change of use and conversions.'

issues.detail: Most tab_items under 'Submission rules' are process text, not requirements: 'We aim to achieve validation within 5 working days'; the invalid-letter email/21-day response (twice); 'Please see the City Council's website for more information and hard copy forms' (twice); the pre-app meeting five-working-days note; 'The checklist will be reviewed by the validation team'; the web link text 'Validation guidance and local information requirements (PDF: 1.2 MB)'; and the CD/paper copies note mixed with roof-plan tick boxes. The app row 'Pre-application advice' ('you seek pre-application advice although you are not required to do so') is also not a requirement.
issues.evidence: tab_items: 'We aim to achieve validation within 5 working days.'; 'All invalid reasons ... sent to InvalidPlanningApps@liverpool.gov.uk within 21 days.'

issues.detail: Duplicate tab_items: the invalid-letter instruction (with and without the email address), 'Help and guidance ... hard copy forms' (x2), 'For some major development, a hard copy...' (x2), and the roof-plan/CD text (from both the householder and full checklists).

The current PDF could not be read to list all its numbered items (items run to at least 64). Grokbot's own excerpts already show some current items that have no requirement row of their own: 30 External Wall Construction Report (only a fragment in the Employment row), 19 Arboricultural Method Statement (mislabelled), 54 Refuse and Recycling Management (only the 2013 checklist wording is used), and HRA for sites in or near the Mersey Estuary SPA/Ramsar (only in tab_items). This needs a full check against the PDF.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpts: '29 Employment and Skills Statement 30 External Wall Construction Report'; '...may require HRA ... 54 Refuse and Recycling Manage'

issues.detail: Not checked against source: WebFetch could not read the PDF (robots-disallowed on liverpool.gov.uk/media/), and the shared web budget ran out before the forms-and-checklists page could be checked. The issues above rely on the council landing page plus Grokbot's own quoted text.

summary: Grokbot's link is the current list (last updated 24/10/2025), but it took the date from PDF metadata and added rows from 2013 per-type checklists that contradict the current list. Many triggers taken from the 2025 PDF belong to neighbouring items (Heritage, Tree Survey, Sustainability, Structural, EIA), and the tab_items are mostly process text. The PDF itself could not be fetched (robots-disallowed), so missing items are only partly checked.
